The '''Asteroid Mining Registry''' was an organization that operated during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The prospector [[Jag Murrock]] registered a claim with the Registry for the rights to an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]] that contained [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]] deposits.
